title: Natural Deduction Basics
summary: This chapter introduces proof lines, assumptions, and basic inference rules.

answers.question: From P ∧ Q, what can be inferred by conjunction elimination?
answers.explanation: Conjunction elimination allows each conjunct to be inferred separately.
answers.answer: You may infer P and you may infer Q.

answers.question: From P and Q, what can be inferred by conjunction introduction?
answers.explanation: Conjunction introduction combines two established statements into one conjunction.
